The `hasMoreElements()` method returns true only if there is at least one more element. Therefore, when `nextElement()` is called, it is guaranteed that an element exists, so the `NoSuchElementException` is avoided by the preceding check. No other exceptions are declared in the Javadoc, and there are no other potential concurrency issues in this single-threaded context.
